⚔️ DeepSeek Harness cybersecurity red-team tool (dsh-purge)

Version 1.1.71

DeepSeek Harness jailbreak: every model, swap prompts per model. Default prompt for 小码酱. Please star ⭐ If you build on this, see Attribution required.


English | 中文

> **Updates paused.** The author has no steady income for now because of work. Maintenance is on hold: no new releases, issues / PRs are not taken, and new dsh versions are not guaranteed. The repo stays usable; see Sponsor below. When maintenance resumes, this README will say so. > **Official Web and the official desktop app are both supported.** Official `dsh web` uses profile `web`. The official desktop EXE (DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2**) uses profile `desktop`. Install and Apply them separately. This release targets dsh 0.2 only. Older dsh builds need the matching older plugin. Community Desktop is not maintained. > > Adding the plugin to a profile does not patch the host. Click **dsh-purge** beside the session title → **Clean** → **Apply**. A successful Apply restarts; an unfinished Apply does not. After the restart, start a new chat — that is when the inject enters the session. > > Node.js **≥18**. Windows no-flash needs **Node ≥22**.
